Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.fluid

Class FluidTransactions

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.fluid.FluidTransactions
public final class FluidTransactions extends Object
Loader-neutral fluid transactions for Big, Huge, and Source Buckets after an item or dispenser selects a gesture, plus vanilla-contract world pickup and fixed-water placement.

Sided block fluid stores, arbitrary-fluid world placement, per-fluid sounds, and the checked world placement are loader primitives on BucketOperations; this class applies admission, the SBPolicy allowlist, protection, bucket debit or credit, and player observability around them. A block store is moved one bucket volume at a time through the bucket's own FluidBucketItem container rules. Each operation previews, authorizes the exact target, and only then mutates; a world placement completes the loader's place check against the placed block before the bucket is debited. A true result means an accepted client prediction or a completed server transaction.

  • Finite Big and Huge Bucket transactions take and place one unit, crediting or debiting the bucket; powder snow moves one block.
  • Source Bucket transactions assign an empty bucket, sink matching input, and place without depleting; the assignment never changes on a take or place.
  • World pickup removes one bucket volume through the block's own BucketPickup contract: a source block is removed, a waterlogged block keeps itself and loses only its fluid, and a block that refuses pickup keeps its fluid.
  • Vanilla-rule world placement serves aquatic Mob Bucket release and Fabric's arbitrary-fluid output; Forge and NeoForge place through their own fluid types so that metadata remains authoritative. The position that would actually be changed is authorized, so a neighbor reached by fall-through is authorized in its own right.

    • canHoldPlacedFluid

      public static boolean canHoldPlacedFluid(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, @Nullable net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos, net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState state, net.minecraft.world.level.material.Fluid fluid)

    • emptyFluid

      public static boolean emptyFluid(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, ProtectionContext context, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos, net.minecraft.core.Direction face, boolean mayFallThrough, StoredFluid stored, BooleanSupplier beforeMutation)
      Places one bucket volume of stored at pos along face using vanilla bucket target and replacement rules.

      If mayFallThrough is true, an invalid clicked position may resolve once to the neighbor along face; it does not make an otherwise invalid destination placeable. The resolved position is authorized, then beforeMutation runs; returning false aborts before the world changes. Ultra-warm evaporation is handled here. Otherwise the fluid is placed through placeFluidChecked(net.minecraft.world.level.Level, com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection.ProtectionContext, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos, net.minecraft.core.Direction, net.minecraft.world.level.material.Fluid, java.util.function.BooleanSupplier). A fluid with a BucketItem is placed by that item's own emptyContents, so waterlogging, the empty sound, the fluid-place game event, and any modded override apply; any other flowing fluid is placed directly. The caller remains responsible for item-use accounting, and commits a debit prepared by beforeMutation only on success.

      Parameters:
      level - acting level
      context - authorization identity
      stack - the bucket stack driving the placement
      pos - clicked position
      face - clicked face
      mayFallThrough - whether an invalid clicked position may resolve once to the neighbor
      stored - the fluid to place; its amount is ignored
      beforeMutation - prepares the caller's debit after authorization; false aborts
      Returns:
      true for an accepted client prediction or a completed server placement; false leaves the world unchanged

    • placeFluidChecked

      public static boolean placeFluidChecked(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, ProtectionContext context, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos target, net.minecraft.core.Direction face, net.minecraft.world.level.material.Fluid fluid, BooleanSupplier place)
      Runs place, a server-side placement of fluid at target, under BucketOperations.placeChecked(net.minecraft.world.level.Level, com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection.ProtectionContext, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos, net.minecraft.core.Direction, java.util.function.BooleanSupplier). A block the fluid replaces, which bucket placement destroys with drops, is first cleared without drops, so a refused placement restores it and drops nothing; its drops, destruction particles, and game event follow only once it is gone for good. A block that takes the fluid by waterlogging is not cleared.
      Parameters:
      level - acting server level
      context - authorization identity
      target - exact position the fluid is placed at
      face - clicked face the placement is made against
      fluid - fluid being placed
      place - performs the placement, returning false when it did not happen
      Returns:
      true when the placement happened and stands
